info.name: AI Foundry Passthrough API v2
info.description:
Full API surface for the AI Foundry Passthrough module — every endpoint, organised for QA testing.

Required headers on every request:
  Authorization: Bearer {{bearerToken}}
  x-kpmg-charge-code: {{chargeCode}}
  x-kpmg-region-override: australiaeast

Auth flow:
  OAuth 2.0 Implicit — authenticate via Authentication → Generate OAuth2 Token, then set bearerToken variable.

ID chaining:
  Many requests auto-capture returned IDs into collection variables (agentId, threadId, runId, messageId, fileId, vectorStoreId, projectAuthName) so downstream requests work without manual copy-paste. Run requests in folder order for the best experience.

Environments:
  Switch baseUrl and projectId variables to target DV / QA / UAT / PROD.

item.name: Authentication

exec: // After authorising, copy the token from the Authorization tab and set it here:

request.description:
Use the Authorization tab on this request to run the OAuth 2.0 Implicit flow:
  1. Click the **Authorization** tab
  2. Type = **OAuth 2.0**
  3. Click **Get New Access Token**
  4. Sign in with KPMG credentials
  5. Click **Use Token**
  6. Copy the `access_token` value
  7. Paste it into the `bearerToken` collection variable (Collection → Variables tab)

Token lifetime: ~1 hour. Repeat when you see 401 responses.

**Scope:** `api://{{clientId}}/user_impersonation` (delegated / user-impersonation)
**Audience:** `https://ai.azure.com`

item.description: Generate an OAuth 2.0 Bearer token and set the bearerToken collection variable before running any other request.

item.name: Agents

request.description:
Returns a list of all assistants in the specified project.

Operation ID: `List_Agents`

Creates a new assistant in the specified project. Requires `CreateAgent` permission in ProjectAuthorization (or ProjectOwner role).

Operation ID: `Create_Agent`

Captured: `agentId`

Creates an agent with an Azure AI Search tool. Triggers the ai_search_index_check policy fragment — validates indexName + projectConnectionId, checks caller is AgentOwner, writes rows to AgentSearchIndexMapping.

Returns 409 if the index or agent is already mapped.

Auto-captures: `agentId`

Retrieves details for a specific assistant.

Operation ID: `Get_Agent`

Updates an existing assistant's configuration.

Operation ID: `Modify_Agent`

Updates an agent's AI Search tool. The ai_search_index_check policy validates the payload, updates AgentSearchIndexMapping rows, and enforces ownership (AgentOwner must match caller).

Returns 409 on index/agent conflict.

Deletes an assistant. Expects HTTP 204 on success.

Operation ID: `Delete_Agent`

item.description:
CRUD operations for Azure AI Foundry assistants (agents) within a project.
Policy enforces ProjectAuthorization membership and CreateAgent permission.

item.name: Threads

request.description:
Creates a new conversation thread. Optionally pass initial messages.

Operation ID: `Create_Thread`

Captured: `threadId`

Retrieves a thread by its ID.

Operation ID: `Get_Thread`

Updates thread metadata.

Operation ID: `Modify_Thread`

Deletes a thread and all its messages. Expects HTTP 204.

Operation ID: `Delete_Thread`

item.description:
Conversation thread lifecycle operations.
Threads are project-scoped and can hold multiple messages and runs.

item.name: Messages

request.description:
Lists all messages in a thread. Supports `limit` and `order` (asc/desc) query parameters.

Operation ID: `List_Messages`

Adds a message to a thread. Role must be `user` when adding via API.

Operation ID: `Create_Message`

Captured: `messageId`

Retrieves a specific message.

Operation ID: `Get_Message`

Updates message metadata.

Operation ID: `Modify_Message`

item.description: Message operations within a conversation thread.

item.name: Runs

request.description:
Lists all runs within a thread.

Operation ID: `List_Runs`

Creates and starts a run. The run will begin processing the thread's messages with the specified assistant.

Operation ID: `Create_Run`

Captured: `runId`

Creates a streaming run. Response is Server-Sent Events (SSE). Note: Postman will buffer the full SSE stream before displaying the response.

Operation ID: `Create_Run` (with stream=true)

Retrieves the status and details of a run. Poll this to track run completion.

Status values: `queued`, `in_progress`, `requires_action`, `cancelling`, `cancelled`, `failed`, `completed`, `expired`

Operation ID: `Get_Run`

Updates run metadata.

Operation ID: `Modify_Run`

Cancels an in-progress run. Only works when the run is in `in_progress` or `queued` status.

Operation ID: `Cancel_Run`

Submits tool call outputs back to a run that is in `requires_action` status. Set `toolCallId` from the `required_action.submit_tool_outputs.tool_calls[*].id` in the Get Run response.

Operation ID: `Submit_Tool_Outputs_To_Run`

Lists all execution steps in a run. Use the returned step IDs to populate `stepId`.

Operation ID: `List_Run_Steps`

Retrieves details for a specific run step.

Operation ID: `Get_Run_Step`

item.description:
Run lifecycle and step operations for executing an agent on a thread.
Streaming runs use Server-Sent Events (SSE) — add `stream=true` query parameter.

item.name: Thread and Run (Combined)

request.description:
Creates a new thread from the provided messages and immediately starts a run against it.

Operation ID: `Create_Thread_And_Run`

Captured: `threadId` (from `thread_id`), `runId` (from `id`)

Creates a thread and run with SSE streaming enabled.

Operation ID: `Create_Thread_And_Run` (with stream=true)

item.description:
Creates a thread and immediately starts a run in a single API call.
Supports streaming via `stream=true`.

item.name: Project Authorizations (Admin)

request.description:
Returns all project authorization records for the project. Caller must be the Project Owner.

Operation ID: `List_Project_Authorizations`

Creates a new ProjectAuthorization record.

Required: ProjectID, ProjectName, ProjectStatus (Active|Inactive), ProjectOwner

Optional (mutually exclusive): User, SecurityGroupName

Optional: ModelName (semicolon-separated), CreateAgent (Yes|No)

Auto-captures: `projectAuthName` from response.Name

Updates an existing ProjectAuthorization record.

Mutable: ProjectStatus (Active|Inactive), ProjectName, ModelName, CreateAgent (Yes|No)

Immutable (returns 400 if included): Name, ProjectID, CreatedBy, CreatedDate, ProjectOwner

Operation ID: `Update_Project_Authorization`

Deletes a project authorization record. Expects HTTP 204.

Operation ID: `Delete_Project_Authorization`

item.description:
Manage project authorization records that control which users/service principals have access to a Foundry project.

**Restricted to Project Owners only** (GET/PATCH/DELETE of existing records).
The `x-kpmg-charge-code` header must match a configured Foundry service.

Required fields for Create: `ProjectID`, `ProjectName`
Record name format: `WB-FOUNDRY-{sequence}` (e.g. `WB-FOUNDRY-0001`)

item.name: Agent Authorizations (Admin)

request.description:
Returns all agent authorization records for the project. Restricted to Project Owner.

Operation ID: `List_Agent_Authorizations`

Creates an AgentAuthorization record.

Required: AgentID, AgentName, AgentStatus (Active|Contained|Deleted), AgentOwner

Optional principal (mutually exclusive): User, SecurityGroupName, AppID

Permissions (each Yes|No): CreateAgent, ReadAgent, UpdateAgent, DeleteAgent, CreateThread, CreateRun, UpdateRun, ReadThread

Sharing: ShareStatus (Yes|No), ShareWith (semicolon-separated emails)

Operation ID: `Create_Agent_Authorization`

Updates an existing AgentAuthorization record.

Mutable: AgentStatus (Active|Contained|Deleted), permission fields (Yes|No): CreateAgent, ReadAgent, UpdateAgent, DeleteAgent, CreateThread, CreateRun, UpdateRun, ReadThread, ShareStatus, ShareWith

Immutable (400 if included): AgentID, AgentName, AgentOwner, AppID, SecurityGroupName, CreatedBy, CreatedDate

Operation ID: `Update_Agent_Authorization`

Sets AgentStatus to Contained. The containment-check policy blocks ALL operations on the agent with 403 Forbidden regardless of individual permission fields.

Restore access by setting AgentStatus back to Active.

item.name: Soft Delete Agent (Set AgentStatus to Deleted)

request.description: Soft-deletes an agent by setting AgentStatus to Deleted. The containment-check policy treats Deleted identically to Contained — all operations return 403 Forbidden.

Permanently deletes an AgentAuthorization record. The deletion is logged to VersionHistory.

Operation ID: `Delete_Agent_Authorization`

item.description:
Manage agent authorization records controlling per-agent permissions.

Caller must be the Project Owner, Agent Owner, or have `UpdateAgent` permission.

Required fields for Create: `AgentID`, `AgentName`, `AgentOwner`
Allowed `AgentStatus` values: `Active`, `Contained`, `Deleted`
Record name format: agent-level RowKey (e.g. `WB-AGENT-0001`)

item.name: Agent Mappings (Admin)

request.description:
Performs bulk add/remove operations on the agent mappings for a project authorization.

Operation ID: `Mutate_Agent_Mappings`

item.description: Bulk mutation of agent mappings within a project authorization.

item.name: Version History

request.description:
Retrieves the project authorization version history audit log. Omit `agentId` to get project-level history.

Operation ID: `List_Version_History`

query.description: Agent ID to retrieve history for

request.description:
Retrieves the version history audit log specifically for a given agent authorization.

Operation ID: `List_Version_History` (with agentId)

item.description:
Audit trail for project and agent authorization changes (AC5).
Use `agentId` query param to retrieve agent-level history; omit to retrieve project-level history.
